description: This source file contains a comprehensive set of pytest-based unit tests for testing the Android project template implementation within the project initialization framework. It tests project creation, parameter validation, content replacements, script execution, and handling of various edge cases.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration class representing project metadata and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration class for supported project types, e.g., Android.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data class encapsulating template initialization details including commands and environment configurations.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing projects from templates.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Provides template data and management for different project types.

classes.name: AndroidTemplate
classes.description: Template class for Android projects, including validation, content replacement, and initialization logic.

methods.name: test_android_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests basic project setup and directory structure creation for an Android project.

methods.name: test_android_template_validates_parameters()
methods.description: Validates parameter checking logic within the Android template class.

methods.name: test_android_template_basic_replacements(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Ensures that project info placeholders are correctly replaced in files during project creation.

methods.name: test_pre_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Verifies that pre/post processing scripts are executed during project initialization.

methods.name: test_android_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Checks that initialization info returned by the template contains correct command and environment details.

methods.name: test_android_with_missing_template_config(temp_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests behavior when configuration files are missing, expecting failure handling.

methods.name: test_processing_scripts_failure_handling(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Simulates failure in post-processing script execution and checks proper failure handling.

methods.name: test_template_project_variations(template_dir, temp_dir)
methods.description: Tests project creation with various project info configurations, including minimal and detailed.

methods.name: test_special_character_handling(template_dir, temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures that project info containing special characters is handled correctly and reflected in output files.
